scope: Read-only review of current camera against bounded original ARM64, serialized source and verdict images. No production camera edit; no full camera/runtime/image parity or process stability claim.

native_validation.limits: Object lookup, strings, native delegates, camera/UI method boundaries and Unity Invoke are bounded observation hooks. ccr, FocusWinner, Positioner.OnEnable, Canvas.ccs and blend lookup branch instructions execute intact. The actual Unity scaled-time scheduler and Cinemachine camera pipeline are not run by this oracle.

confirmed_findings.current: LateUpdate always rediscovers first human rig and its normal CameraTarget; there is no winner cache, initial loser focus or delayed winner target.
source_behavior: Local player registration sets both Round and Paused Follow/LookAt to local normal CameraTarget.
OnRoundEnded(localWon,true) caches winner, immediately focuses loser normal CameraTarget, invokes FocusCamerasOnWinningPlayer after .625 scaled seconds.
OnMatchEnded(localWon,false) has the same immediate loser target, but schedules winner focus only when localWon. A normal Campaign loss stays on local loser normal target.
If no opponent exists, use local as winningPlayer and immediately focus its WinnerCameraTarget.
FocusCamerasOnWinningPlayer uses NetworkPlayer.winnerCameraTarget, not normal CameraTarget.
OnRunnerDestroyed when IsRetrying is false clears winner cache and cancels pending FocusCamerasOnWinningPlayer Invoke.
Pause selects the Paused camera without resetting the shared target; delayed Invoke follows Unity scaled-time behavior.

source_target_poses.both_children: Direct children of each original rig root; winner target is not a new chest-attached approximation.

confirmed_findings.impact: Natural Campaign loss in Build17 alone cannot exercise the missing victory and RoundEnd branches.

confirmed_findings.current: LateUpdate moves human normal target to chest.x when dead OR passedOut.
source_behavior: Only OnDeathEvent is subscribed; OnPassedOutEvent is not subscribed.
cea makes a sticky bool true. OnEnable does not clear it.
After death, normal target follows original Bone_Chest.x, keeps its current target world y, sets z0.
Source positioner exists on every original rig normal target; changing to an enemy loser requires that enemy target positioner too.
confirmed_findings.impact: A pass-out can move the current human camera earlier than source, and an enemy loser cannot be tracked correctly by a human-only update.

confirmed_findings.current: CinematicIntro to Round always selects a 1.5s source blend; no explicit source Brain.ResetState call.
source_behavior: After network camera activation, if newState4 and GameMode2 call brain.ResetState().
This clears root blend state; treating Practice like an uninterrupted ordinary CinematicIntro to Round blend is incomplete.
Other modes retain their configured phase transition blends.

confirmed_findings.current: SelectCamera takes the last matching entry.
source_behavior: Otherwise first ANY->specific To wins, then first specific From->ANY, then last ANY->ANY, then default.

confirmed_current_matches: States4/5/6 all select the same Round camera; state5/6 need no separate verdict lens.
